content: Yesu ꞌina tononoyao ꞌaedi ꞌiꞌutudi

Ta niꞌatu tuta gidalina be Ataona Sagalina ꞌana ꞌasiyata sida guinuwe, ta Yesu ꞌimwalatonina ꞌaene niꞌatu ꞌina tuta ꞌiapwesama be baleꞌu gete ꞌida pilisine be ꞌitatauya Tamana ꞌena. Ta Yesu ꞌina bodao ꞌiobobomedi sinabwana, ꞌenega tuta ꞌana ꞌebe eꞌale ꞌenega ga ꞌana laba ꞌina ꞌebe losalowa ꞌena ꞌiobobomedi.
Ta Seitani niꞌatu Yudasa ꞌena ꞌilugu ga ꞌienuwa saꞌuyena be ꞌaene Yesu ꞌida sipupuye. Yudasa nina tauna Saimoni Isikaliota natuna. ꞌEnega tuta nina ꞌidi ꞌeꞌai solanaya
Yesu niꞌatu ꞌimwalatonina ꞌaene Yaubada yage maiboꞌadi ꞌiꞌebwaꞌena be tauna ꞌida loina, ta wate ꞌimwalatonina ꞌaene tauna Yaubada ꞌenega ꞌimai, be wate Yaubada ꞌena ꞌida ila.
ꞌEnega ꞌidi ꞌebe ꞌeꞌai nina ꞌenega Yesu ꞌitoolo ga ꞌana ꞌoama ꞌialolona ta tawelo ꞌiꞌewena ga ꞌilogadiwanena.
Ta bwasi ꞌisiwena gaeba sinabwana ꞌenaya ga ꞌieꞌale be ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌaedi ꞌiꞌutudi be muliyega tawelo nina ꞌilogadiwanenaya ꞌenega ꞌaedi ꞌitalaꞌiꞌilidi.
Ta tuta nina Yesu ꞌimai Saimoni Pita ꞌenaya, Pita nina ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana, geyaꞌabo ꞌaegu ꞌuꞌutuꞌutudi.”
ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌiona, “Nigeya ꞌumwalamwalatoni toꞌase tuta gete yaguiguinuwa ꞌemuya ta esi maꞌetamo be ꞌuda mwalatoni.”
Ta Pita Yesu ꞌieonena, “Geyaꞌabo wate ꞌebweu tuta ꞌaegu ꞌuꞌutuꞌutudi.” Ta Yesu Pita ꞌenana ꞌieꞌisena, ꞌigwae, “ꞌEguma geyaꞌabo ꞌaeyo yaꞌutuꞌutudi ꞌoyo nigeya gosiyagu.”
ꞌEnega Saimoni Pita ꞌitagwala, ga ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana, boboꞌana! Ta geyaꞌabo ꞌaegumo, ta esi nimagu be debagu wate ꞌuda ꞌutudi.”
Ta Yesu ꞌigwae, “ꞌEguma yaisigedi ꞌomi niꞌatu waꞌesiweya, ꞌilobwenemi be ꞌaemimo wada ꞌutudi be ꞌenega bwalami maiboꞌana ꞌida ꞌesasadi. Ta niꞌatu ꞌomi waꞌesasemi, ta nigeya ꞌaene maiboꞌami.”
Ta Yesu niꞌatu ꞌigimi sinapuna yaita tauna maꞌetamo ꞌida sipupuye, nate ꞌenega ꞌigwae, “ꞌAimi nigeya ꞌesasemi.”
Ta niꞌatu ꞌaedi ꞌiꞌutudi, ꞌenega ꞌana ꞌoama ꞌiꞌote limena ga ꞌimiyatowa ta ꞌediya ꞌiona, ꞌigwae, “Wamwalatonina toꞌase yaguinuwena ꞌemiya, nai nigeya?
Ta ꞌomi niꞌatu waeesegu ꞌaene ꞌaboꞌagu Toeꞌita, ta wate ꞌInapwana, ga nate ona ꞌaiꞌaila.
ꞌAboꞌagu ꞌimi ꞌInapwana be wate ꞌimi toeꞌita, ta niꞌatu ꞌaemi yaꞌutudi, ꞌenega ꞌomi ꞌilobwenemi be wate gosemiyao ꞌaedi wada ꞌutudi,
tuga toꞌase nadigega yaguinuwena ꞌemiya wada etotowanegu be wada guinuwa nadigega gosemiyao ꞌediya.
Ta yaona ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌemiya ꞌaene nigeya ꞌebweu yaita toguinuwa ꞌina ꞌinapwana ꞌida loetana sinena, ta nigeya ꞌebweu wate toepilialeale ꞌana toetune ꞌida loetana sinena.
Ta niꞌatu eꞌita nidi getedi wamwalamwalatonidi, ta ꞌabo waguinuwedi ꞌebe gwausowala wada loba.

“Yage getedi nigeya ꞌaene maiboꞌami manumi yaonaona, ta esi taudi yaesinuwediya manudi yaonaona, ta Buki Tabu ꞌina simana mali tai manuna ꞌigwae, ‘Tai nina tauna ꞌana masula yaꞌebwaꞌena, ꞌisanaila ga ꞌietalauwalegu.’ ꞌEnega ona nina ꞌana ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌiabe ꞌiapwesa.
Niꞌatu yage nidi gete ꞌemiya yasimanedi muliyega sida apwesa, be ꞌenega tuta nina siapwesa wada emisegu ꞌaene ꞌaboꞌagu tuga.
“Onaꞌaiꞌaila, maꞌetamo yaetunemi tomota ꞌediya be ꞌabo yaita ꞌitagwala ꞌemiya, nate tauna niꞌatu ꞌitagwala ꞌeguya, ta wate ꞌitagwala ꞌagu toetune nina ꞌenaya.”
Yesu ꞌana telesipupu manuna ꞌigimi simanena
Ta niꞌatu Yesu yage nidi getedi ꞌionaedi ga nuwana ꞌimwau sinabwana, ꞌenega ꞌina tononoyao ꞌediya ꞌisimana apwesa ga ꞌigwae, “Yaona ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌemiya ꞌaene ꞌebweu ꞌemiyega maꞌetamo ꞌida sipupuyegu.”
Ta tononoyao maiboꞌadi taudimo ꞌediya siedunedune, ta nuwadi ꞌiowana sinabwana. Manuna ꞌina ona ꞌana mwalatoi nigeya simwalamwalatoni.
Ta ꞌebweu ꞌina tonono, tauna Yesu gosiya ꞌaiꞌailina, selabenaya ꞌiꞌeno ilaila,
ta Saimoni Pita tupwana ꞌimiyaila, ꞌenega Pita nina nimanega ꞌieonena, “ꞌUda enaide yaita tauna manuna ꞌionaona?”
ꞌEnega tai nina ꞌiꞌeno ilaila Yesu selabenaya ga tenanaya ꞌiona, ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana, yaita sana manuna ꞌuonaona?”

Ta Yesu tai nina ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, “ꞌIabe beledi yagitomwa be yaepwasa be yaꞌebwaꞌe, tauna nate tai nina.” ꞌEnega Yesu beledi nina gidalina ꞌiꞌewena ga ꞌiepwasena ga Yudasa ꞌiꞌebwaꞌena, Yudasa tauna Saimoni Isikaliota natuna.
Ga tuta nina Yudasa beledi ꞌiꞌewena Seitani ꞌena ꞌilugu, ga Yesu Yudasa ꞌieonena, “ꞌUlomanini be ꞌimu guinuwa nina ꞌuda guinuwe.”
Ta taudi Yesu maꞌenao siꞌeꞌai nigeya ꞌebweu yaita ꞌediyega ꞌimwalamwalatoni toꞌase Yesu ꞌina ona Yudasa ꞌenaya ꞌana mwalatoi.
Tauna Yudasa ꞌidi mani ꞌana toꞌitaꞌiꞌita ꞌenega sinuwena ꞌaene Yesu ꞌieonena be tauna Yudasa ꞌitatauya be ꞌidi sagali gwegwena ꞌida gimwane, nai ꞌitatauya be ꞌaina mani gomabeso ꞌida ꞌebwaꞌedi.
ꞌEnega Yudasa beledi nina ꞌiꞌenina, ga ꞌilomanini ga ꞌiapwesa ꞌatamanaya, ta niꞌatu ꞌiboi.
Loina auwauna Yesu ꞌenega
Yudasa niꞌatu ꞌipilisinedi, ga Yesu ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Niꞌatu tuta ꞌimai saba be ꞌaboꞌagu Tomota Natuna ꞌigu esaesa ꞌida apwesa, be ꞌaboꞌagu Yaubada ꞌina esaesa wate yada gieapwese.
Onaꞌaiꞌaila, Yaubada tauna ꞌenega ꞌigu esaesa ꞌida gieapwese manini.
Natugwao, tuta gidalina namo ꞌena ꞌaboꞌagu maꞌemi, ta maꞌetamo waꞌebesegu, nadigega lowa me Yudia ꞌediya yasimanaꞌesa, yagwae, ‘Sena nina ꞌena yatatauya ꞌomi nigeya sawesawemiya be ꞌena wawawai.’
“ꞌEnega ꞌomi wate gete tuga loina auwauna yaꞌebwaꞌemi, be ꞌatemiyega wada eobooboboma ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna ꞌenaya, nadigega ꞌaboꞌagu yaobobomaꞌesemi,
be ꞌimi eobooboboma ꞌenega tomota yaudi sida mwalatonimi ꞌaene ꞌomi ꞌagu tomuliyao.”
Pita ꞌina eyaseyase Yesu manuna Yesu ꞌisaꞌu apwesena
ꞌEnega Saimoni Pita Yesu ꞌienaidena, ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana, mwaꞌo batu ꞌutatauya?” Ta Yesu ꞌieonena, “Nigeya sawesawemuya be tuta gete ꞌenaya ꞌumuliyegu, ta esi ꞌetamo be ꞌuda muliyegu sena nina ꞌena.”
ꞌEnega Pita Yesu ꞌienaidena, ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana, toꞌase manuna gete tuga geyaꞌabo yamulimuliyeyo? Niꞌatu yatagwalegu be manuyo tuga yada mwawasa.”
Ta Yesu Pita ꞌena ꞌigwae, “ꞌImu ona ꞌeguya nigeya yaemiemise, ta yasimana ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌemuya ꞌaene boiboi gete ꞌenaya ꞌuda eyaseyaseyegu matoi, be muliyega kakaleko ꞌigwagwane.”
